title: The Loyalty War (Part 2)
description: Steve got tired of the tenth taco that never comes, so he started his own truck with one rule: the tenth taco is free, today, no card. Now Donna and Marco have a common enemy, and a common problem.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're back on Snazzie FM, and the taco war has a third truck. Donna, Marco, you're both on the line again. And so is the man who started his own.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Steve has a truck now.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Hey, guys. Yeah. It's called Steve's. One rule. Buy nine tacos, the tenth one is free, today, in your hand, no card.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: You parked between us, Steve.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: On the curb. The eight inches. He's in the eight inches!

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: It's a public street, Marco. Public.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: ...That's my line. He took my line.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: So let me understand the model, Steve. The tenth taco is actually free. Real. Redeemable.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Real, Ronnie. I hand it to you. No machine. No stamp. I looked a man in the eye yesterday and I gave him a free taco, and he cried.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: [confirmation-en] An honest taco. Imagine.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: It can't be free, Steve. You have to eat the cost somewhere. Where's the tenth taco coming from?

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: I built the price of the tenth into the other nine, Donna. Same money. You just, you actually get the thing at the end.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: That's... that's just our prices with a taco at the end.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Don't say it like it's clever, Marco.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Donna, we need to talk.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: ...I know.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Are the two of you forming an alliance? On the air?

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: It's a temporary, eight-inch alliance, Ronnie. We move our trucks together. We squeeze him out.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: And we launch a new card. Buy NINE tacos, the tenth is free, AND the eleventh.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Does the eleventh exist?

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: The eleventh is conceptual, Barry.

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: See, that's the thing, though. I already came back. I have your nine cards. I have Marco's nine cards. I have forty cards stuck on nine. I'm just gonna cash all of those at MY truck.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Those are OUR stamps!

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: You can't honor our cards at his truck, Steve, that's, that's forty free tacos!

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Forty free tacos, guys. Finally.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Move your truck, Steve!

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: Honor your own cards!

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: Stamp them yourselves!

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: There's no tenth stamp, Steve!

lines.speaker: caller-steve
lines.text: At MY truck there is!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, the loyal customer opened a competitor to collect on the loyalty that the loyalty card never paid out.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: That's the beauty of loyalty, Barry. <p:0.3> It always comes back around. It just doesn't always come back to you.

lines.speaker: caller-donna
lines.text: ...So who's getting a card at Steve's?

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: I mean. The tenth's actually free.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Three trucks, one curb, forty cards, and the only honest taco in town. <p:0.3> We'll see who's parked there tomorrow. Don't touch that dial.
